name: docs-vault
description: Seven skills for a project's docs/ Obsidian vault: init bootstraps it, recall reads it, record writes it, todos lists the open follow-ups, lint checks it for broken links and malformed journal days and decisions, graph colour-codes the graph view, and preset saves and applies your Obsidian settings. The vault keeps notes on what is true now, a curated daily journal of what happened with plain follow-up checkboxes, and a Decisions folder for why, and leaves everything else to the project's Conventions.md. Requires kepano/obsidian-skills.
